column3: Facing screen right. Scared: soft body squashed low and pulled half back under the shell, head tucked, eye stalks bent and eyes wide looking up at the sky, small worried wobbly closed mouth line. Same side view as the sheet.
Facing screen left. Cheerful and confident: one stubby arm pointing forward toward screen left, other hand on hip, big friendly eyes, wide closed smiling mouth line. Standing upright on two feet.

Facing screen right. Surprised and curious: body stretched tall, head lifted high out from the shell, eye stalks fully up, eyes very wide, small closed mouth. One water drop splash on top of the head between the eye stalks. Same side view as the sheet.

Facing screen right. Sliding very fast and joyful: body stretched long and low like a surfboard, leaning forward, shell tilted backward, eye stalks swept backward by speed, big happy eyes, closed smiling mouth line. Tail end flicked upward. Same character, no speed lines, no water.

Facing screen right. Sliding very fast and joyful, the next drawing of a bouncing slide: body stretched long and low but rippled in a wave shape with the middle raised, shell tilted forward slightly, eye stalks swept backward, big happy eyes, closed smiling mouth line. Same character, no speed lines, no water.

Facing screen left. Running after a friend in a big happy hop: both feet off the ground with knees bent, leaning forward, both stubby arms reaching forward toward screen left, scarf flying back, big eyes looking forward, wide closed smiling mouth line.
